g1.label: 1. While I ___ (walk) to the station…
g1.why: After while, the longer action in progress takes the past continuous.

g2.label: 1. … it ___ (start) to rain.
g2.why: The short action that happens during the walk takes the past simple.

g3.label: 2. While we ___ (plan) our pitch…
g3.why: After while, the longer action in progress takes the past continuous.

g4.label: 2. … the internet ___ (stop).
g4.why: The sudden short action takes the past simple.

g5.label: 3. While she ___ (check) her phone…
g5.why: After while, the longer action in progress takes the past continuous.

g6.label: 3. … the lecturer ___ (give) the deadline.
g6.why: The short action that happens during the longer one takes the past simple.

g7.label: 4. They ___ (eat) lunch at their desks…
g7.why: They were in the middle of lunch when the librarian came: past continuous.

g8.label: 4. … when the librarian ___ (come) over.
g8.why: After when, the interrupting action takes the past simple.

g9.label: 5. Our reporter ___ (present) our idea…
g9.why: The pitch was in progress when the card went up: past continuous.

g10.label: 5. … when the timekeeper ___ (hold) up the card.
g10.why: The short interrupting action takes the past simple; hold → held.

g11.label: 6. What ___ (you / do) when I called?
g11.why: A question about an action in progress: was/were + subject + -ing.

g12.label: 6. … when I ___ (call) you last night?
g12.why: The short action that interrupts takes the past simple.
